content.comment_body: Is there a way to transfer more data records to the cloud from a single [product_name] with [version_no]? Currently, only 64 lines can be sent. If you use the SD card's webpage, you can access all inputs, outputs, and 64 additional blocks, but cloud usage requires a separate line for each input and output. Is this limitation designed to discourage combining [version_no] and [version_no] devices?

analysis.insight_summary: The user points out a restriction where only 64 data records can be sent to the cloud from one [product_name] with [version_no], while the local SD card webpage allows broader access to device functions. This difference raises concerns about possible intentional limits to prevent connecting different device versions. The main usability issue is the cap on cloud data transfer.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to transfer more than 64 data records from a single [product_name] with [version_no] to the cloud and is seeking solutions or workarounds for this limitation.
